dedupe_keys.name: mirt overzicht netherlands multi year programme for infrastructure spatial planning and transport project pages and yearly overview editions 2017 2026

description: MIRT Overzicht is the Dutch government's public overview of the Multi-year Programme for Infrastructure, Spatial Planning and Transport, the joint programme of the State and regions for roads, railways, waterways, water safety and spatial development. The site read on 2026-09-28 explains that the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management takes part in every MIRT project and funds its share from the Infrastructure Fund or the Delta Fund, for example for motorway, rail or river widening schemes. Its sitemap lists 54 running project pages, 6 realised projects and 98 documents; a sample project page on the A2/N2 Eindhoven ring road describes the problem, the alternatives studied, their effects and the documents. Yearly overview editions are listed from 2017 to 2026, the latest as an accessible online edition on overheid.nl. Coverage is the Netherlands. Access is free and no licence is stated. Caveats: the project list page renders by script and could not be read as a list, project budgets and schedules were not checked, and the content is in Dutch and descriptive, not a dataset. It supports planned infrastructure and adaptation studies, such as listing future motorway, rail and flood defence works to include in network or climate scenarios. No related Dutch infrastructure programme record is catalogued.
